nearbyPlaces.response: array of place summaries including externalPlaceId, placeName, placeImageUrl, address, coordinates, rating, reviewNum, petPolicy and wishlisted

photoUploadUrl.request: { files: [{ type: PROFILE | POST | REVIEW, fileName }] }
photoUploadUrl.notes: uploadUrl is a presigned S3 PUT URL valid for 10 minutes; response order matches request order

photoDownload.notes: owner-only; downloadUrl is valid for 10 minutes

postList.responsePhoto: posts[].thumbnail is null or { photoId, photoKey }; resolve photoId through photoDownload

postDetail.responsePhoto: photoId/photoUrl are nullable representative fields; photos[] contains { photoId, photoKey }; resolve each photoId through photoDownload

postCreate.notes: POST photos do not use POST /photos; the post endpoint creates and associates them from uploaded photoKey values

currentUser.responsePhoto: profilePhoto is always present; photoId is null for default and downloadUrl is a 10-minute presigned URL

profilePhotoUpdate.notes: PROFILE upload -> S3 PUT -> POST /photos -> PATCH this endpoint; null restores the default

missingContracts: No owned-stamp list or stamp-image endpoint is documented.
The documented owner-only GET /photos/{photoId} authorization conflicts with post list/detail guidance that asks clients to resolve other authors' post photo IDs through that endpoint.
Post list summaries do not include a total photo count, so an accurate multi-photo +N badge cannot be rendered.
Allowed upload MIME types and maximum file size are not documented.
Required or signed Content-Type behavior for the S3 PUT is not documented.
Cleanup behavior for uploaded photo keys when a later request fails is not documented.
Photo deletion and post-photo edit contracts are not documented.
